name: agentic-media-kit
description: Let AI coding agents capture a running UI, compose Instagram-ready videos with Remotion, and publish them to a password-gated viewer you can open on your phone.
author: Renan Winter Spatin (https://github.com/rwspatin)

scripts.check: node --check apps/media-viewer/server.js && npm run typecheck && for f in scripts/*.sh; do bash -n "$f" || exit 1; done
